evidence.claim: Westrock Coffee describes itself as an integrated coffee, tea, flavors, extracts, and ingredients solutions provider serving retail, food service and restaurant, convenience store and travel center, non-commercial, CPG, and hospitality industries, with branded and private-label coffee plus extract solutions for cold brew and RTD offerings.

Farmer Bros. says it is a coffee roaster, wholesaler, equipment servicer, and distributor of coffee, tea, and allied products serving customers including independent restaurants, foodservice operators, chains, hotels, casinos, healthcare facilities, gourmet coffee houses, and foodservice distributors.
Farmer Bros. disclosed that during fiscal 2025 its top five customers accounted for approximately 3% of net sales, suggesting low concentration by top customers despite foodservice exposure.

Farmer Bros. sold its Northlake, Texas facility and non-direct-store-delivery coffee business to TreeHouse Foods for approximately $100 million, shifting the remaining business toward DSD and service-oriented foodservice coffee distribution.

memory_update.text: WEST should be retained as the highest-quality underfollowed candidate for the private-label coffee and beverage-solutions node because it has direct restaurant/foodservice, private-label, extract, RTD, and beverage-development exposure.

FARM is a highly direct but speculative micro-cap exposure to foodservice coffee, DSD distribution, and equipment service; later layers must stress-test balance sheet, liquidity, commodity sensitivity, and route economics.

THS is an adjacent private-label platform with acquired coffee-roasting capability; include as an underfollowed coffee-infrastructure mapping but verify how much of the acquired coffee business is restaurant or foodservice versus retail private label.

JVA is a speculative shadow candidate below the preferred market-cap threshold; it fits wholesale/private-label/foodservice coffee screening but requires proof of material restaurant or multi-unit foodservice exposure.

Need a follow-up pass on coffee-equipment service networks, beverage syrup/concentrate suppliers, cold-brew extract manufacturers, and DSD beverage distributors that may be public but not classified as coffee companies.

node: Private-label coffee roasting, beverage ingredients, DSD beverage supply, and equipment service
summary: Expanded the public-market map for restaurant and foodservice coffee/beverage supply. The strongest underfollowed exposures are not consumer-facing restaurant brands but behind-the-scenes roasters, beverage-solution platforms, private-label manufacturers, direct-store-delivery networks, and equipment-service providers. WEST and FARM are the closest fits to the node; THS is a larger private-label platform with acquired coffee-roasting capability; JVA is a micro-cap speculative shadow candidate with private-label and foodservice exposure but requires liquidity, customer concentration, and margin verification.
